seoContent.title: ASCII File Tree Generator
seoContent.intro: The ASCII tree generator is a free online tool that allows you to easily create visual representations of your project structure. Perfect for documenting your projects, creating diagrams for your README.md files, and sharing your code organization with your team.

whyUse.title: Why use an ASCII tree for your documentation?
whyUse.para1: Whether you're working on an open source project, documenting a web application, or presenting a professional project's architecture, an ASCII file tree offers several advantages:
whyUse.benefit1: Clear documentation: Visualize your entire project structure in just a few lines of text
whyUse.benefit2: Universal compatibility: Simple text format that displays correctly on GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket and all text editors
whyUse.benefit3: Easy integration: Copy-paste directly into your README.md files without additional formatting
whyUse.benefit4: Version control friendly: Structure changes are easy to track in your Git commits

howToUse.title: How to generate a tree for your README?
howToUse.para1: Our ASCII tree generator simplifies creating file structures for your projects. Here's how to use it:
howToUse.step1: Drag and drop your folders and files directly into the interface or use the file selector
howToUse.step2: Organize your tree structure by adding, modifying or deleting elements as needed
howToUse.step3: Configure options: alphabetical sorting, maximum depth, hidden file display
howToUse.step4: Copy the generated ASCII result and paste it into your README.md file or documentation
howToUse.para2: The tool automatically generates a file tree in ASCII format compatible with Markdown, making it ideal for your GitHub projects, technical documentation and code structure presentations.

useCases.title: Structure examples and use cases
useCases.para1: The ASCII tree generator is particularly useful for:
useCases.useCase1: Visualizing the folder structure of a web project (React, Next.js, Vue.js...)
useCases.useCase2: Documenting the organization of a Python project with its modules and packages
useCases.useCase3: Creating tree diagrams for Node.js projects and their file structure
useCases.useCase4: Presenting project architecture in a professional README.md file
useCases.para2: Whether you need to visualize a Windows project structure with the tree command, or want to create a tree for a Linux project, our online tool works on all operating systems without installation.

features.title: Generator features
features.para1: Our ASCII tree generator offers many features to meet all your documentation needs:
features.feature1: Intuitive drag & drop interface to quickly import your files and folders
features.feature2: Interactive editing: add, modify or delete elements with a few clicks
features.feature3: Simple export: copy the result or download it as a text file
features.feature4: Advanced options: customize depth, sorting and display according to your preferences
features.feature5: Real-time preview of your ASCII tree structure
features.para2: All these tools are available for free, without registration and directly in your web browser.
